# organizers-service

An events platform where organizers publish events and attendees buy tickets.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open http://localhost:8000/docs for the interactive OpenAPI UI.

## Test

```bash
ruff check . && pytest
```

## Container

```bash
docker build -t organizers-service:local .
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 organizers-service:local
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/organizers` | List organizers |
| `POST` | `/organizers` | Create an organizer |
| `GET` | `/organizers/{organizer_id}` | Get one organizer |
| `PATCH` | `/organizers/{organizer_id}` | Update an organizer |
| `DELETE` | `/organizers/{organizer_id}` | Delete an organizer |
| `GET` | `/events` | List events |
| `POST` | `/events` | Create an event |
| `GET` | `/events/{event_id}` | Get one event |
| `PATCH` | `/events/{event_id}` | Update an event |
| `DELETE` | `/events/{event_id}` | Delete an event |
| `GET` | `/attendees` | List attendees |
| `POST` | `/attendees` | Create an attendee |
| `GET` | `/attendees/{attendee_id}` | Get one attendee |
| `PATCH` | `/attendees/{attendee_id}` | Update an attendee |
| `DELETE` | `/attendees/{attendee_id}` | Delete an attendee |
| `GET` | `/tickets` | List tickets |
| `POST` | `/tickets` | Create a ticket |
| `GET` | `/tickets/{ticket_id}` | Get one ticket |
| `PATCH` | `/tickets/{ticket_id}` | Update a ticket |
| `DELETE` | `/tickets/{ticket_id}` | Delete a ticket |

## Deployment

* `deploy/k8s/` - Kustomize base (Deployment, Service). Set `DATABASE_URL` through the
  referenced Secret.
* `deploy/terraform/` - AWS ECR + ECS Fargate service. Run `terraform init && terraform
  plan` with your own VPC and subnets; nothing is applied automatically.

See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for components and design decisions.

"""Database engine, session factory and declarative base."""

import os
from collections.abc import Iterator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./app.db")

_connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False} if DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite") else {}
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args=_connect_args, pool_pre_ping=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

"""SQLAlchemy ORM models."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, Integer, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db import Base


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class Organizer(Base):
    __tablename__ = "organizers"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.db import Base, engine
from app.routers import attendees, events, organizers, tickets


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Organizers Service", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.include_router(organizers.router)
app.include_router(events.router)
app.include_router(attendees.router)
app.include_router(tickets.router)


@app.get("/healthz", tags=["ops"])

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "example title",
    "priority": "example priority",
    "resolved": True,
}


def test_create_and_get_ticket(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post("/tickets", json=PAYLOAD)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["title"] == "example title"
    assert created["priority"] == "example priority"
    assert created["resolved"] is True
    fetched = client.get(f"/tickets/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_ticket_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/tickets", json=PAYLOAD).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/tickets", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_ticket(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/tickets", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(
        f"/tickets/{created['id']}", json={"title": "updated title"}
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["title"] == "updated title"


def test_delete_ticket(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/tickets", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/tickets/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/tickets/{created['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_unknown_ticket_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/tickets/999999").status_code == 404


def test_create_ticket_rejects_missing_required_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/tickets", json={}).status_code == 422

FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /src
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
RUN pip install .

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
RUN useradd --uid 10001 --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
WORKDIR /home/app
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz', timeout=3)"]
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - name: Install
        run: pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check .
      - name: Test
        run: pytest -q

  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Build image

        with:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: organizers-service
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: organizers-service
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: organizers-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: organizers-service
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: organizers-service:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: organizers-service-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
